tasks.title: Console e2e scripts can reuse setup and TOTP helpers without changing setup behavior
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior item 2 and its console-setup.test.sh regression check: extract req/location/csrf/form_token_args/expect/expect_location, TOTP wait/password helpers and the reusable setup-to-signed-in-owner two-factor flow into a sourced library. Preserve console-setup.sh auto/legacy/two-factor behavior, output, action-bound form tokens and secret handling; do not change its existing stub tests. This pure refactor prepares the shared setup interface consumed by T2.

acceptance.expected: exit 0 with the existing test unchanged; legacy/two-factor flows and all four form layouts retain action-specific form tokens, replay behavior and 0 fixture-secret occurrences in output.

acceptance.command: shellcheck -x e2e/console-lib.sh e2e/console-setup.sh && bash -n e2e/console-lib.sh && bash -n e2e/console-setup.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0 from the repository root; the library is sourced without executing a scenario on import.

tasks.title: Compose e2e runs the rendered probe snippets within 10000 ms and CI requires the result
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior items 1, 3 (all ten scenario steps and parent cleanup) and 4; all Checks and Completion evidence; Acceptance evidence 3, Counterexample One interval (deploy), Rollout order and Security impact CI/secret handling. Use T1 library and merged api/console main. Add dev-only optional prefills, exact pre-id HTML decoder and literal entity tests, new console-probes scenario before persistence, published-image skip and CI gate. Run actual rendered env/docker/Compose/restart text in a temporary directory with caller COMPOSE_FILE/COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME, fresh TOTP owner setup, result timestamps from GET /locations and the literal 10000 ms window, not a timeout derived from the implementation.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; snippet decoding selects the requested pre id and matches literal decoded strings for &, <, >, " and '. Existing setup regression suite still passes unchanged with 0 secret occurrences in output.
exit 0 from the repository root, including the newly added/tracked scripts and sourced library.
exit 0 for every shell script, including the new files.
exit 0 for every helper, including e2e/snippet.mjs.
exit 0 for every tracked JSON file.

exit 0; dev prefills are literal http://api:3000, pulse-probe:dev and pulse-dev_default. All setup rules still pass, especially rules 3/4; full/minimal/demo and common image pins retain their existing configuration.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && bash scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh && bash scripts/init-secrets.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0; the remaining checks of the touched CI lint job pass. Docker Compose version is at least 2.23 as required by that job.
exit 0; repository lint/workflow validation, CLI typecheck and full CLI tests remain green.

exit 0 with sibling main revisions including this spec's merged api/console changes; output contains ==> All checks passed and four new success lines: the specified literals ok: docker run probe e2e-run reported within 10 s, ok: compose probe e2e-compose reported within 10 s and ok: console probe locations, plus a secret-free success line for the rotated probe reporting within the same bound. The existing ok: manual incident privacy also remains. The new step runs the actual rendered snippets on pulse-e2e_default, verifies Awaiting first result then Reporting, and obtains lastResultAt >= host t0 with the observing poll starting <= 10000 ms after t0 for both starts and the rotated restart. Old/new secrets each receive 200 on /probe/checks during overlap; revoked e2e-compose gets 401 and its location history remains. Both created secrets and the rotated secret have 0 hits in step output, API/console logs and console database files. Probe containers, snippet project and work directory are removed on success and failure before parent network teardown.

exit 0 on the unchanged full published-image setup; literal skip: console probe locations (published images) and ==> All checks passed are printed, and the skipped scenario performs 0 console token mutations or snippet launches.

acceptance.command: gh pr checks && gh pr view --json body --jq .body
acceptance.expected: CI lint and e2e-dev pass; e2e-dev requires the exact ok: console probe locations line. PR lists new ok lines and independent service revision SHAs printed by CI, full-suite compatibility and check results, with 0 secrets. Security checklist names evidence for executing rendered commands only in the throwaway directory, shell/YAML decoding, token/log/database secrecy and cleanup on both success and failure. README/dev README/AGENTS describe the new settings, commands, scenario and CI gate.
